      About this item

      • Personalized Wooden Plaque for Dad & Grandpa – Custom fist bump design with kids’ names, perfect for Father’s Day or birthday celebrations. A heartfelt gift that captures family love and bond.
      • High-Quality 2D Wooden Sign – Crafted from premium wood with a detailed 2D design, this plaque offers a timeless look and durable construction, ideal for display on desks, mantels, or shelves.
      • Heartfelt Father’s Day Gift – Celebrate Dad, Grandpa, or Husband with this meaningful wooden plaque. A customized keepsake that makes a perfect Father’s Day or birthday gift for the special man in your life.
      • Customizable for Family Names – Personalize with the names of the kids or grandkids for a unique, one-of-a-kind gift. This plaque is a great way to showcase family bonds and create lasting memories.
      • Ideal Home Décor for Fathers & Grandpas – Featuring a sturdy base for easy display, this plaque makes a perfect addition to any home or office space, bringing warmth and personal touch to any room.
